Android asks for permission once and later captures are instant and reliable. While it lasts, the session uses power like a screen recording and the system shows its icon. You can close it from the notification.
The session closes after each capture: no permanent icon or battery use, but Android asks for permission every time.

resources.string: Recorded and saved in the chat, with the text by minute
Paste or write here what you are going to read. Each paragraph will get its minute.
Rehearse to see how it scrolls. Recording starts after a three-second countdown.
Recording. You can stop the text and resume whenever you want.
A note (.md or .txt) from the phone
No guide: write, or bring an image, a PDF or a note
Saved; it is transcribed so you can see what was understood
It doesn\'t leave the phone. It arrives as a document: it has to be downloaded and opened by hand.
Its link downloads the page instead of opening it
Tap it and it opens, without downloading anything. Works well over WhatsApp or email. All links expire on their own.
The file is uploaded to a public service that isn\'t ours: anyone with the link can open it while it lasts. Don\'t use it for anything private.
Upload and give me the link
Tap the link to copy it. Careful: %1$s.
All services were tried. There may be no connection or they may be down: they belong to other people and go down without warning. You can always share it as a file.
No audio or music saved yet.
This song has no lyrics yet.
One microphone per person. Each one holds theirs while speaking and releases it when done; the transcript comes out with the names.
Nothing here yet. Type below and add.
At least two names are needed, one per line or separated by commas
It was already in the project
The drawing has nothing to draw
The graphics card couldn\'t handle the drawing: %1$s
Drag: the point goes in the crosshair, above your finger · two fingers move the drawing
Release to place the point · drag a handle to move it · ✓ finishes
Drag to mark a part · two fingers move the drawing
%1$d Civil 3D objects were saved without their graphics: save it with PROXYGRAPHICS = 1 or export to LandXML
The model has nothing visible in 3D
Long-press to leave only that one
Tap two points of the model
Converting the Revit file to IFC…
%1$d drawing fonts are missing: tap Aa above to add them
This drawing asks for fonts that are not on the phone; its texts use similar ones and may not fit in their boxes:
No font that the drawing names is missing.

Copy them from your PC and add them here: SHX fonts are in C:\\Program Files\\Autodesk\\AutoCAD 20xx\\Fonts and TrueType ones in C:\\Windows\\Fonts. PinDesk can\'t bring them: they belong to Autodesk and Microsoft.
The ones that are not .shx don\'t come with AutoCAD: they are TrueType fonts from Windows and Office. Copy them from C:\\Windows\\Fonts (the file is in parentheses) and add them with “Add fonts…”.
The drawing doesn\'t state its units: it is fitted to the paper
The speech model needs to be downloaded (about 40 MB, only the first time) and there is no connection. Connect and try again.
Could not transcribe: the audio could not be decoded.
That speech engine doesn\'t load on this phone (Whisper needs 64 bits). Choose Vosk in Settings.
Could not transcribe: the engine failed.

Google\'s recognizer doesn\'t have the language installed on the device. In Settings → System → Languages → Speech recognition → Google → Offline languages, download the language; or choose Vosk or Whisper.
The one from Google\'s keyboard, offline. Needs Android 13 and the language downloaded in “Speech recognition → Offline languages”.
Download the Vosk model (zip) to import it
Download the Whisper %1$s files to import them
That file is not a model I know (vosk-model-*.zip, tiny/base/small-*.onnx, *-tokens.txt).

What turns audio into text, on the phone and offline. Vosk is fast and light; Whisper understands natural speech better but is slower and bigger; it is the default, as on the PC. The model is downloaded only once.
Whisper size: tiny is the fast one and makes the most mistakes; base, the middle ground; small, the most accurate and the slowest.
Which language is spoken in the audio. Vosk and Google download that language; Whisper is told, so it doesn\'t guess others.
Second language (Whisper only): in each note it checks which of the two is spoken.
With both languages mixed in one note, Whisper can leave each part as it was said or put everything in the first one, translating the rest.
Each one as it was said
Could not download. Check the connection.

For voice notes and recordings of classes or meetings: it understands Spanish, meetings and classrooms much better than Whisper (half the errors or fewer). Choosing it downloads %1$d MB, needs about %2$s GB of memory while transcribing and takes quite a bit longer than Whisper. License %3$s.
Qwen3-ASR is downloaded (%1$d MB, license %2$s) and transcribes notes and recordings. It needs about %3$s GB of memory while transcribing; if it ever fails, Whisper is used.
Qwen3-ASR is downloaded: choose it to use it, or delete it below.
Qwen3-ASR needs a 64-bit phone with 6 GB of memory or more; on this one Whisper is used.
Downloading Qwen3-ASR… %1$d %%. Meanwhile Whisper is used.
Could not download Qwen3-ASR: %1$s. Choose it again to retry; meanwhile Whisper is used.
There is nothing that can be joined: only photos, drawings, notes and PDFs
Photos from this chat will show up here
Videos from this chat will show up here
Files from this chat will show up here
Links from this chat will show up here
Voice notes will show up here
Drawings from this chat will show up here
What you pin to the top will show up here
This file is no longer there
Here goes whatever you want to find again
Write a note, or tap the clip to save a file, a page or a project.
This deletes itself if you don\'t touch it. Keep it to hold on to it.

“Cosmos” is the blue sky of the projects\' solar system, across the whole app. “Automatic” turns it to night from eight in the evening to seven in the morning, and also during the day if the room is dark: the phone\'s light sensor tells it.

Asks the screen for its highest refresh rate (90 or 120 Hz) across the app: the stroke sticks to your finger instead of lagging a step behind. If a screen can\'t do it, it drops to 60 by itself. Turn it off if you prefer longer battery life.
On OLED screens black turns the pixel off: it looks blacker and uses less power. On an LCD screen it looks washed-out grey, so leave it off.
How long is it and which way does it go?
The dimension is dictated: you type how long it is
The dimension measures: it says what is there
That space isn\'t closed: the fill leaks out somewhere
Trace the line over something whose length you know and type it. From then on, dimensions come out in that unit.
No scale: dimensions come out in pixels
Each row is a group: the pin bar shows one button per group, and tapping it again unfolds its siblings. The pin opens with a two-finger double tap on the image.
Full-screen editing, the one that opens with the pencil. Everything fits, so by default all tools are there: here you remove what you don\'t use and group the rest your way.
Copy the screen with the drawing
The canvas tools shown when annotating over a DWG or DXF drawing. It is the same engine: here you only choose which ones. The engine\'s dimension tool is off because the drawing has its own.

When annotating a DWG or DXF drawing, the style goes in the side panel with undo and redo, as on the canvas. Off: the simple editor, everything in the bottom bar. The tools are those of “Drawing bar”.

The ones you take to annotate a PDF, a Word file or a book without leaving the reader. It is the same canvas engine: here you only choose which ones. Text, images and the area tool stay in the full editor.
Panels and the magnifier go on the opposite side, so your arm doesn\'t cover what you are looking at.
Units: %1$s · the origin is the grey cross, and it is the same for all series
Each color is a different series: tapping another switches table.
There is no coordinate table on the clipboard
Window mode: move the image inside
Window mode: drag to move the image inside; tap to place the frame
The blue pencil button in the bar: trace reference lines that are later hidden or deleted without touching the drawing. Not needed for a quick annotation.
Take the page out as a pin
Take the page out as a window
Each line is a curve. Piecewise: x^2 if x<0; 2x if x>=0
z in terms of x and y
Accepts + − × ÷ ^, parentheses, sin cos tan sqrt abs ln log exp, pi and e
Tap one to see it large; long-press it to drop it in the center of the view right away.
Select something in the drawing and it will stay here for good.
There is no text on the clipboard to paste.
Copy the cells in Excel or Sheets and come back here. You can fix whatever is needed before inserting it.
There is no table on the clipboard. Copy some cells and tap “Paste” again.
Long-press a tool and drag it: to another row to join that group, or to the very bottom to take it out of the bar.
The same for the layer drawn over the screen. More fits there than on the pin, but the bar still covers what you annotate.
Which font is used in simple editing. In advanced editing you still choose it on the fly.
Anything opens it. It is what to send if the other side is going to edit it again.
Exactly the same image, without touching a pixel, taking about half the space. In exchange, some old places won\'t open it.
Pinning one of these words on its own opens its tool instead of a text pin. Tap a row to change its words: they are separated by commas and can\'t contain spaces.
Separated by commas. A word you often copy inside a text is a bad candidate: you would no longer be able to pin it as text.
There is no app to open this file
What\'s pending in all your lists: tick it right there or jot one down with “+”
Your latest screenshots and the days they have left
Record the audio and put screenshots at their minute

A floating bar appears over everything: “Capture” saves the whole screen at that minute, and crop saves only a piece you choose. When you finish, the note goes into this chat with its screenshots and is transcribed.
On the phone, the microphone is recorded. If the meeting is on this same phone, Android may mute it while the call is using it.
A class is already being recorded
Could not open the microphone: another app may be using it
Drag to choose the area for screenshots
Tap ✕ again to discard the recording
Class saved with %1$d screenshots. For the text, tap “Transcribe” on the chat note.
Takes more space than the note alone (check the quality). Screenshots come from the video itself, full screen, and Android shows that the screen is being recorded.
Records the video of this screen with the microphone
Records the audio; “Capture” saves the whole screen instantly and crop only a piece
Write a note for this minute (it can be empty)
No transcript yet: tap “Transcribe” on the chat note and it will appear here by itself.
The audio of this class can\'t be found
Long-press a bookmark to remove it
720p video at 10 fps: the smallest (about 180 MB per hour)
1080p video at 15 fps: about 300 MB per hour at most
The screen as is at 30 fps: small text is readable, takes more space
Could not record the screen: only the audio is recorded
The video went into the chat, but without audio there is no note to transcribe
An in-person meeting: records with the app in the background and the screen off; “Photo” and “Clip” use the back camera at full resolution
The phone on the table: the usual voice note. “Photo” and “Clip” with the back camera.
The phone propped up facing the room: the whole video of the meeting (HEVC if the phone has it, otherwise H.264). The voice note comes from its audio.
1080p at 30 fps, about 2.2 GB per hour with H.264 (less with HEVC)
720p at about 2.5 Mbps: for long meetings, a bit over 1 GB per hour
1080p for the first hour and, if it goes on, 720p
With Photo, Clip, pause and Finish. Without it, the same buttons are in the notification.
